summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The MRP SynthEquity Nasdaq 100 ETF (SNTQ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that combines synthetic exposure to the Nasdaq-100 Index with US Treasury securities. The fund seeks long-term capital appreciation while targeting downside protection through a portfolio of purchased call options and Treasuries. SNTQ was launched on Jul 7, 2026 and is issued by Measured Risk Portfolios.
